dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A primary 'O' shaped structure on the lower mid-flank features a jagged, high-contrast perimeter with a sharp gradient transition to a lighter interior. A secondary complex 'C' structure superior to it shows a more fragmented, speckled edge. A third elongated annulus on the anterior flank exhibits a softened, lower-contrast gradient on its dorsal boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: The highest density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters is localized in the posterior-dorsal region, where multiple small blobs are closely packed. A secondary, sparse distribution of isolated high-intensity blobs is visible along the ventral transition of the mid-flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary lower-mid 'O', the superior 'C' structure, and the anterior elongated annulus form an obtuse triangular relationship. Expanding to include the centroid of the dense posterior cluster defines a broad quadrilateral across the lateral surface.
